About: LeadForge — how to read this sheet
Tier
A ≥ 80 · B 60–79 · C < 60 · DQ = hard-disqualified by your ICP rules (tier is FIT only — see Contactability/Status for reachability)
Score
0–100, sum of weighted factors; see 'Why This Score' per row for the top drivers
Email Tier
valid > role > risky > catch_all > unknown (invalid emails are dropped)
Email (Inferred)

NOT a published address: the address this domain's own naming convention implies for the named contact (derived from a real email already found there). Confirm before use; never counted in the 'with email' figure.
DM Conf
0–1 confidence the agent assigned when labeling the decision maker from site snippets
Likely Need (Hook)
auto-suggested outreach angle from detected need signals + your offer
Verified On
timestamp of the newest evidence for the row; older than your staleness window = re-verify
Source
which engine discovered the business (gosom = Google Maps)
v0.3 columns
fit/contactability are graded separately on purpose — a hot-but-uncontactable lead and a lukewarm-but-call-ready one are never blended.
Fit
0–100, industry/need/size/geography/business-model/data-confidence — same number as Score, drives Tier
Contactability
0–100, separate: DM + best email + validated phone + registry corroboration + mobile — never affects Tier
Status
READY (tier A/B and contactability ≥ 50) · CALL_ONLY (validated phone — call regardless of whether the email is also eligible) · RESEARCH (no validated phone yet) · DQ (hard-disqualified)
Next Action
phone-first: CALL a named contact, or the switchboard, before EMAIL; shows the live outreach state once a lead is enrolled in a campaign
Entity Type
what the public company registry says: corporate_active/_inactive/_unknown, unmatched (likely sole trader), or unchecked (no lookup run)
Lawful Basis (Email)
the basis an unsolicited email would rest on under your region's rules and freemail policy — 'none' = do not email
Registry Name / Match
the matched company's legal name and the name-similarity score (0–1) that accepted the match; 'n/a' = no match
Chain
shares a domain or phone with another row in this database (same operator, multiple locations) — '-' = independent as far as this data shows
Site Status
live (crawled, pages fetched) / dead (<code or error>) / not crawlable (robots) / redirects to <host> / unreachable (attempted, nothing came back) / not crawled
Email Confidence
plain-language affinity + tier for the exported Email address
All Hooks
every need signal that fired, not just the top one shown in the hook column
Draft Subject/Body/Grade/Author
the newest non-rejected drafted message for this business in this campaign — drafted, never sent; approve with `leadforge outreach approve`, send only after `--live`.
Drafts sheet
every non-rejected drafted message (all steps) for this run's businesses, with the To address and used fact, for review before approving — nothing on this sheet has been sent.
Note
Contact data is public-source and probabilistic. Confirm before high-stakes outreach; honor opt-outs via `leadforge suppress add`.
